theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_fbl_plane_ball_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ ball 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
